# Veloxis Global

> Veloxis Global is a real estate marketing agency based in Delhi NCR, India. We specialize in high-converting landing pages, Google & Meta Ads management, and WhatsApp CRM automation exclusively for real estate developers, brokers, and channel partners.

## Core Services

- [High-Converting Landing Pages](https://veloxisglobal.com/services/high-converting-landing-pages): Lightning-fast, mobile-first property landing pages designed to turn ad clicks into site visit bookings.
- [Meta & Google Ads Performance](https://veloxisglobal.com/services/paid-ads): Hyper-local paid advertising campaigns on Google Search, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and YouTube targeting genuine home buyers in Delhi NCR.
- [AI & WhatsApp Automation](https://veloxisglobal.com/services/ai-automation): Instant lead routing, automated WhatsApp follow-ups, and CRM integration ensuring zero lead leakage and sub-1-minute response times.

## Industry Focus

- [Real Estate Marketing](https://veloxisglobal.com/industries/real-estate): End-to-end marketing framework for residential and commercial developers in Delhi, Noida, and Greater Noida. Specializing in reducing CPL, increasing site visits, and scaling broker inquiries.

## Case Studies

- [Delhi Real Estate Developer](https://veloxisglobal.com/case-studies/delhi-real-estate-developer): Took a luxury property developer from zero online presence to a predictable weekly site-visit pipeline using a dedicated landing page, Google & Meta Ads, and WhatsApp automation over 6 months.

## Service Areas

- Delhi (South Delhi, Central Delhi, Dwarka)
- Noida (Sector 150, Expressway, Central Noida)
- Greater Noida (Noida Extension, Knowledge Park)
